summary.zh: 为幻灯片和文档套用统一的配色与字体
summary.en: Apply consistent color and type themes to decks and documents.

description.zh: 提供 10 套预设配色与字体搭配，选定后统一套用到幻灯片、文档、报告或网页上，也能按需生成一套新主题。适合需要成套视觉风格但不想逐页调样式的场景。
description.en: Ships ten preset palettes with font pairings, applied consistently across slides, documents, reports or web pages, and can compose a new theme on request. Suits work that needs a coherent look without restyling page by page.
